Subject: Exploring Redwood for Brightlytics — 20m sync?

Hi Alex,

I work on the SDR team at Redwood Inference — I noticed Brightlytics just crossed a self-serve usage threshold (saw a concentrated spike over the last 48h) and wanted to see if a short 20-minute sync would be useful. A quick call helps us surface low-effort config changes (batching, prefix caching, and a few quantization options) that can materially reduce token spend and improve tail latency while you ramp.

Would you and an engineer be open to a 20-minute run-through? High level agenda:
- quick rundown of what triggered the usage alert
- relevant runtime/quantization levers for typical analytics assistants
- recommended next steps (trial Dedicated vs. optimizing hosted settings)

If yes, I can drop calendar options — we have availability tomorrow or early next week. I’m cc’ing Marissa (AE) so she can join for product fit and pricing context.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the heads up. We are seeing a burst tied to an internal beta of our analytics copilot (recent signups from two product teams). I’ll loop in our engineering lead, Sam, on the call.

A few quick notes from our side:
- We’re most interested in latency under 300ms for the MVP and sensible cost controls while the beta runs.
- Security: we operate in a VPC for some customer data; Marissa, if you can flag how Redwood Private or Dedicated works, that would be great.

I’m available Fri 6/19 after 1pm ET or Mon 6/22 in the morning ET. Send over an agenda and a calendar invite — Sam will join if the session is technical.

Best,
